raw_text:
This file guides Claude Code (claude.ai/code) for TD Studios’ luxury Next.js 15 TypeScript website, synced with v0.app and deployed on Vercel.

**Stack:** Next.js 15.5.4 App Router; TypeScript strict; Supabase/PostgreSQL; Tailwind CSS v3.4.17/PostCSS; Radix UI/shadcn New York RSC; pnpm 10.15.1; Geist; Lucide; Vercel Analytics; Vitest/jsdom; Playwright.

**Structure:** `app/`, `api/`, `components/`, `lib/`, `public/`, `styles/`, `tests/`. Components include `sticky-header.tsx`, `nav.tsx`, `footer.tsx`, `glass-card.tsx`, `frosted-button.tsx`, `page-title.tsx`, `section.tsx`, `json-ld.tsx`, `calendly-embed.tsx`, `logo.tsx`, `analytics-provider.tsx`, `ab-test-wrapper.tsx`, `theme-provider.tsx`, `ui/`. `layout.tsx` provides header, footer, analytics, and iOS viewport fixes; `page.tsx` is homepage; `globals.css` contains global styles.

**Routes:** `/`, `/work`, `/web`, `/dev`, `/social`, `/design`, `/process`, `/resources`, `/faq`, `/contact`, `/book`, `/support`, `/legal`, `/[client]/signin`, `/clients/[client]`. `/pricing` merged into `/faq`; `/services` split into `/web`, `/dev`, `/social`, `/design`. See [ROUTES.md](./ROUTES.md).

**API:** `contact/` POST uses Resend; `chatkit/session/` POST uses OpenAI; `intake/` POST uses Supabase.

**Design:** Dark luxury theme, OKLCH tokens, glassmorphism, mobile-first responsive layouts, accessibility, Geist Sans/Mono, Lucide, 0.625rem default radius, light/dark support, analytics, and A/B testing.

**Environment** (create `.env.local`; see `.env.local.example`): `RESEND_API_KEY`, `CONTACT_TO_EMAIL`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME`, `JWT_SECRET` (minimum 32 characters), `CLIENT_{CLIENTSLUG}_PASSCODE`.

**Commands:**
```text
pnpm dev            # Start development server (Next.js dev mode on port 3000)
pnpm serve          # Start production server on port 3000 (after building)
pnpm build          # Build for production using Next.js
pnpm lint           # Run Next.js linting with ESLint
pnpm typecheck      # Run TypeScript type checking without emitting files
pnpm ci:verify      # Run full CI verification (lint + typecheck + test)
pnpm report:types   # Generate type error report using custom script
pnpm scan:secrets   # Scan entire codebase for potential secrets using secretlint
pnpm scan:secrets:staged  # Scan only staged git files for secrets (used by pre-commit hook)
pnpm test           # Run unit tests with Vitest (single run)
pnpm test:watch     # Run Vitest in watch mode for development
pnpm test:jest      # Run Jest tests (if applicable)
npx playwright test # Run Playwright end-to-end tests
npx playwright test --ui # Run tests with UI mode for debugging
npx playwright test tests/mobile-layout.spec.ts # Run specific test file
pnpm lh:routes      # Run Lighthouse audits on routes using custom script
```

Vitest uses `tests/setup.ts`, `*.spec.ts?(x)`, globals, and `@/` aliases; excludes `**/mobile-layout.spec.ts`, `**/playwright/**`; `passWithNoTests: false`. Playwright tests mobile layout, parallax, touch targets, viewport handling, and `tests/screenshots/`; default configuration (no custom config file).

ESLint errors ignored during builds for deployment compatibility. TypeScript build errors ignored for v0.app integration. Images allow `i.imgur.com`, `via.placeholder.com`, `cdn.platform.openai.com`, `tdstudiosny.com`; AVIF/WebP optimization; `www.tdstudiosny.com → tdstudiosny.com` permanent, 301 redirect. Strict checks: `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `noImplicitReturns`, `noFallthroughCasesInSwitch`; ES2017; `@/*` maps to project root.

**Deployment:** Auto-sync v0.app → GitHub → Vercel. Project: [v0.app/chat/projects/MgSVoHLfRb7](https://v0.app/chat/projects/MgSVoHLfRb7). Use v0.app interface for major changes; consider sync implications for direct edits. `pnpm ci:verify` before commits. Husky installs automatically via postinstall. Pre-commit hook:
```sh
if ! git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | xargs -I{} -r secretlint "{}"; then
echo "🚫 Secretlint found potential secrets in staged files."
```
Pre-push hook:
```sh
branch="$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"
[ "$branch" = "main" ] && { echo "🚫 Direct pushes to main are blocked. Use feature branch + PR."; exit 1; }
if [ -z "$CI" ]; then
pnpm -s scan:secrets >/dev/null || { echo "🚫 Pre-push secret scan failed."; exit 1; }
```
Feature branches and PRs are required; secretlint uses `<REDACTED_USER>/secretlint-rule-preset-recommend`.

JWT portals use `jose`, `JWT_SECRET`, and `CLIENT_{CLIENTSLUG}_PASSCODE`; sign-in `/[client]/signin`; protected portal `/clients/[client]`.

See [docs/architecture-map.json](./docs/architecture-map.json) for infrastructure, DNS/TLS/HTTP verification, integrations, missing infrastructure, and security audits. Last updated 2025-10-10.
